visualRisks.description: Water and road colors are very similar, which could cause confusion.
visualRisks.suggestion: Consider using more distinct colors for water and roads.

visualRisks.description: The lighthouse is not clearly visible against the background.
visualRisks.suggestion: Increase contrast or use a different color for the lighthouse.

navigationRisks.description: The route path does not have any visual indicators (like color changes) to guide the player, which could make navigation difficult.
navigationRisks.suggestion: Add visual cues along the route path for better guidance.
